statements.text: The defendant is a regular customer here, he comes in every morning to buy a Pastel de Nata and a coffee.
statements.press_response: He's always been a nice guy, never caused any trouble.

statements.text: When he tried to pay with that bill, I immediately knew something was wrong. It looked like Monopoly money.
statements.press_response: I have seen a lot of counterfeit bills in my life, and that one was definitely fake.

statements.text: But what also caught my attention was that strange figure I saw near the defendant's pocket. I couldn't make out who it was, but it seemed like they were trying to put something in his pocket.
